data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'cheir', meaning 'hand'. In Christian symbolism, the hand represents faith and divine guidance. The name Mano carries the meaning “Hand” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Mano usually hope their child will grow to embody hand and live with faith, good character and purpose.

This name could be given to a child as a reminder of the divine hand guiding them through life or to signify a deep commitment to God.
